items.name: Normal Magazine
entries: Dual Repeaters magazine. Unlocked at Common.
Deals the weapon's normal piercing damage.
Load Magazine (Bonus Action): expend this magazine to fill the Dual Repeaters with 6 Charges. Each Dual Repeaters attack spends 1 Charge. Magazines do not regenerate.
